title: The Conference of the Birds
author: Farid ad-Din Attar (Masani)
description: Attar's Sufi poem follows birds seeking their sovereign, the Simurgh. Their journey becomes an allegory of spiritual searching, the obstacles of the self and the transformation of those who seek the divine.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.128685).
